notes: SR159 Merci Paris (merci-merci.com), French general concept store. Access: direct HTTP via curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation, no block. Site distinguishes two concepts: 'Dernière chance' (Last Chance, target term) = an evergreen permanent-markdown mechanism, and 'Soldes' = France's regulated dated seasonal sale periods -- kept separate per the Clearance-vs-Sale rule. Found the full 'Dernière chance' family via exhaustive /collections.json enumeration (1919 collections): one site-wide parent (handle last-chance, H1 'Dernière chance', meta 'Une sélection Merci de produits Mode, Maison et Déco & Lifestyle', no discount % or campaign name -- evergreen framing) plus 9 department-scoped children all titled 'Dernière chance - <Department>'. Two of the children (Mode femme/homme) are live-linked in the current desktop megamenu (as 'Last Chance' under their fashion submenus); the parent and the other 7 children were not found in the current desktop megamenu but are confirmed live, populated, and actively maintained: all carry updated_at timestamps of 2026-09-07/08 (today/yesterday) in /collections.json, i.e. genuinely refreshed inventory, not stale/abandoned pages -- included on that strength. All qty values are exhaustive unique-product-ID counts from /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 pagination to exhaustion (last page always <250). EXCLUDED as not genuine Clearance: 'soldes-cachemire' (Merci Days - Cachemire, a dated -X% promo campaign, also 0 products = empty) and 'soldes-30-vert-de-prusse-rose-aurore' (-30% on a linen selection, a dated promo campaign, also 0 products = empty) -- both dropped for two independent reasons (temporary-promo framing per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule, and zero products). No other Soldes/Outlet/Fin de série/Destockage terms found anywhere in the full collection or nav scan.
